messages:
Sam L: Quick Q for security & solutions re: CAIQ mapping for AC-3/SC-13 for customer POC. They want BYOE KMS + tokenization in front. Who owns encryption at rest vs tenant-managed?
Maya P: @Sam L, short answer: Redwood handles platform keys for hosted. If customer requests BYOE, they manage tenant key wrapping; we still manage disk encryption. Need CAIQ text. :thinking_face: 
Rajiv: Client also asked about pricing delta for BYOE and dedicated vs hosted POC. Any ballpark?
Alex (Solutions): For POC, BYOE adds operational runbook and entitlement; we usually add a modest one-time setup fee + monthly surcharge for dedicated capacity. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance.
Emma (Security): For CAIQ responses we should mark 'shared' for controls: e.g., Key Management: Customer = tenant key, Redwood = key usage controls and HSM integration. I'll paste suggested CAIQ phrasing.
Emma (Security): ```
CAIQ control: Key Management (KMS)
Ownership: Shared
Redwood: provides integration, HSM-backed KMS, access logging, and rotates platform keys.
Customer: supplies/controls tenant key material for BYOE; responsible for key lifecycle, rotation schedule, and external compliance attestations.
```
Sam L: perfect. Can we also clarify logging and egress controls? Customer wants logs forwarded to their SIEM and retention 2 years.
DevOps Bot: deployment note: POC cluster created in us-west-2-dedicated-qa
Maya P: We can ship logs via secure syslog or S3 with SSE-KMS. For BYOE, customer owns the KMS used to encrypt logs before delivery. We should call that out in CAIQ.
Alex (Solutions): Add a Logging control mapping too.
Alex (Solutions): ```
CAIQ control: Logging and Monitoring
Ownership: Shared
Redwood: collects operational and audit logs, masks PII at collection point, provides audit export APIs and SIEM forwarding connectors.
Customer: configures retention, SIEM ingestion endpoints, and alerting rules; responsible for redaction of customer-side logs and long-term archival.
```
Rajiv: When do we need security sign-off to move forward with POC? Client wants to start next week.
Emma (Security): Need CAIQ snippets + Table of Contents for evidence for BYOE KMS (network diagram, KMS policy, rotation schedule proof, and access control list). If Alex can provide CAIQ text by EOD, we can do review for POC start.
Sam L: I'll consolidate and send to customer. Action items: Alex — CAIQ snippets + pricing estimate; Maya — logging/syslog + S3 delivery steps; Emma — evidence checklist and minimal acceptable artifacts.
Alex (Solutions): On it. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:
Maya P: I'll drop a sample syslog config and S3 bucket policy template into the shared drive.
Emma (Security): Also flag: network egress boundaries — mark as shared when customer requests VPC peering or private endpoints. Add note about flow logs passing to customer-owned collectors.
Sam L: Thanks team. I'll update the client once pricing is confirmed.
Rajiv: TY everyone — this is high priority, if we can get security and CAIQ snippets reviewed fast we should be able to lock the POC. :party_parrot:
